player_prompt.intro:
Uyimdlali {player_id}. Uyidlala igemu elithi Memory Game.
Injongo yakho kukhetha iiphepha eziningi zokulingana kwiibhodi, kulula mdlali wakho.
Kwexesha lakho, khetha iikahli ezimbili zokuzibeka kwaye ucinge inombolo yeqonga na koloni yekahli yokuqala na yesibini ngokulandelana njenge '[0 1 1 0]', apho ikahli yokuqala ikhona eqongeni 0 na koloni 1, na ikahli yesibini ikhona eqongeni 1 na koloni 0.
Ukuba iikahli zilingana, uyipointi na iikahli zingabaluli. Ukuba azilingani, iikahli zibuyiselwe ngokuthi zibaleke phantsi, e.g. '.'.
Umzimba ude ngokuba zonke iiphepha zikhethiwe.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomathi yokudlula engekho mthethweni. Umdlali {player_id} akazange aphendule ngecala elifanelekileyo kwiikhonkco zesikwere.
invalid_move.already_matched: Umdlali {player_id} ukhethe ikhadi elinye okanye omabini sele ethelekiswa.

game_message.cards_match: Amaqaqabazi akhethiwe nguMdlali {player_id} kwenye izikhundla [{r1} {c1}] neye [{r2} {c2}] akhuphisana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Amaqaqabazi akhethiwe nguMdlali {player_id} awakhuphisani. Amaqaqabazi kwenye izikhundla [{r1} {c1}] neye [{r2} {c2}] ngama {pos1} ne {pos2} mtawana.

outcome.draw: Bobabini abadlali bafumana inani elifanayo lamakhadi.
outcome.turn_limit: Umbono wexesha ulifikele. Umzimba ude. Mdlali 0 waziboleka {score_0} ipointi, Mdlali 1 waziboleka {score_1} ipointi.
